notes:
Save files: Save_1.sav .. Save_6.sav, Global.json, Options.ES3
Uses Unity's Easy Save 3 format (plain JSON). A quirk where some int/bool fields drop their 'value' key is patched automatically.
Inventory item stats are base64-packed bytes - shown decoded in the tree as 'item:<type>' rows.
Inventory is fully browsable/editable through the generic tree (Item/MainCharacterItemData, Inventory/PlayerStorage, Inventory/Inventory_Safe), and typeID fields show a looked-up item name next to the raw number via data/duckov/item_names.json (see data/duckov/README.md - extracted from a local install's own game files, covers 1568 items). Edit > Inventory Editor... opens a dedicated window with a visual grid of the backpack/player storage/safe (colored by occupied/free slot, labeled with names where known), a list of what's in each, and buttons to spawn a brand-new item (by numeric type id) or remove an existing one - it handles this format's own item-tree linking (instanceID references, equipment slotContents, inventory position lists) for you. Backpack capacity isn't stored anywhere in the save (it depends on the equipped backpack item), so that container's grid shows only what's occupied plus a few empty slots to spawn into, honestly noted in the window rather than guessed.
